versions.changelog: Fix SQP-1: added explicit activation boundary and operator-confirmation guardrails to orchestrator/SKILL.md (the nested orchestrator previously lacked the top-level activation/confirmation boundaries the main SKILL.md has).

Fix SkillSpector SDI/SQP flags: removed overbroad 'ANY request' activation, added explicit-approval guardrail, replaced 'absolute/all tools/omniscient/create new realities' language with operator-scoped wording across SKILL.md, all levels/*/config.md, and docs/tier-*.md.
Fix SkillSpector Trigger Abuse false positive: added specific triggers field, narrowed description/when-to-use prose.
Initial publish. Agent hierarchy evolution engine (up to 100 levels of subagents).
